record.original_question: Which Riemannian metrics on the sphere S^n arise as metrics isometric to smooth nested convex surfaces, meaning an iterated chain of complete smooth convex hypersurfaces each embedded as a convex hypersurface inside the next one in some Euclidean space?

evidence.quote: Describe the Riemannian metrics on S^n that are isometric to smooth nested convex surfaces; that is, a complete smooth convex hypersurface in a complete smooth convex hypersurface in ... in a Euclidean space.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Call a Riemannian metric $g$ on the sphere $S^n$ a "nested convex metric" if there exist an integer $k \geq 1$, a Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^N$, and a chain of complete smooth hypersurfaces
$$ M_1 \subset M_2 \subset \cdots \subset M_k \subset \mathbb{R}^N $$
such that:

(i) $M_k$ is a complete smooth convex hypersurface in $\mathbb{R}^N$ (i.e. the boundary of a convex body), and for each $1 \leq i < k$, $M_i$ is a complete smooth hypersurface of $M_{i+1}$ that is convex when viewed as a hypersurface of $M_{i+1}$ (i.e. it lies on the boundary of a geodesically convex domain in $M_{i+1}$ and has positive semidefinite second fundamental form there);

(ii) $M_1$ is diffeomorphic to $S^n$ and the induced Riemannian metric on $M_1$ from the ambient Euclidean structure is isometric to $(S^n, g)$.

Problem: Characterize intrinsically which Riemannian metrics $g$ on $S^n$ are nested convex metrics in this sense.
artifact.status_search_result: No published characterization of Riemannian metrics on $S^n$ realizable as iteratively nested smooth convex hypersurfaces was found. Classical results characterize metrics on $S^n$ isometric to a single convex hypersurface in Euclidean space (nonnegative sectional curvature, by Nash/Pogorelov-type embedding and convexity results), but the iterated/nested version appears to be a recently posed problem with no known solution in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity and convexity of hypersurfaces in spheres
status_evidence.snippet: Studies convex hypersurfaces in spheres and rigidity properties.
status_evidence.claim: Existing literature addresses single convex hypersurfaces in spheres/Euclidean space but not the iterated nested version.

status_evidence.title: Riemannian Submanifolds: A Survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of isometric immersions; the case of nonnegative curvature gives convex hypersurfaces diffeomorphic to spheres.
status_evidence.claim: Classical isometric embedding theory characterizes the one-step convex case; nested chains are not addressed.
